prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a sideswipe while changing lanes claim. Injury: knee injury. The claimant is not represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1249; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Claim opened following report of a sideswipe collision during a lane change on a multi-lane roadway. Both drivers remained on scene. Insured vehicle sustained damage to the right rear quarter panel. Claimant vehicle reports damage to the left front fender. Photos requested from both parties and police report number to be obtained.

Entry 2: Spoke with claimant by phone. Claimant reports pain and swelling in the right knee after the impact and is seeking medical evaluation. Claimant is not represented by an attorney. Explained the claims process, the coverage under review, and the documents needed to proceed. Claimant agreed to send medical records once available.

Entry 3: Recorded statement taken from insured. Insured states they checked the mirror and signaled before moving over but did not see the claimant vehicle in the adjacent lane until contact. Insured acknowledges responsibility for the lane change is open for review pending the scene diagram and witness information. No citations reported at scene.

Entry 4: Reviewed photos from both vehicles and the preliminary police report. Damage pattern is consistent with a glancing side contact. Independent appraiser assigned to the insured vehicle and a rental vehicle authorized for the claimant while the vehicle is inspected. Follow-up call scheduled with the claimant to confirm medical treatment status and knee injury details.

Entry 5: Claimant provided initial medical documentation describing a knee sprain with ongoing physical therapy recommended. Injury claim noted in file and referred for bodily injury evaluation. Estimate for vehicle repair received and under review. Claimant informed of next steps and asked to notify this office of any change in treatment or work restrictions.
